packageRules.description: Keess's own images are versioned by chart/Chart.yaml appVersion, which `make tag-release` bumps and GoReleaser publishes a matching Docker tag for, so chart/values.yaml deliberately leaves image.tag empty. Renovate has no version to track here, and pinDigest actively breaks the chart: in #83 it resolved the empty tag to `latest` and wrote a digest override that outranks appVersion, pinning every cluster to 1.3.3 across three releases.
